title: Sr Engineer IT Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**
================

A Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, secures, and scales an organization's core technology systems across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines deep hands-on expertise across enterprise compute, storage, and virtualization with knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **System Reliability, Monitoring & Capacity Planning:** Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable systems across hybrid and cloud environments. Define SLIs/SLOs, build out the monitoring and observability roadmap, and analyze resource usage to forecast and manage capacity as traffic and data grow.
* **Infrastructure as Code, Automation & CI/CD:** Architect and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines and code-driven infrastructure, automating provisioning and reducing manual operational work to enable rapid, safe, and repeatable delivery.
* **Hybrid & Cloud Platform Engineering:** Serve as technical lead for the full lifecycle of on-prem and cloud-based resources — compute, storage, backup, and virtualization — and design secure, cost-effective cloud architectures, including migration of on-premises workloads to the cloud.
* **FinOps & Cost Optimization:** Drive FinOps best practices by monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing cloud spend, including cost allocation and reporting.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting & Incident Response:** Serve as the final escalation point for high-impact technical challenges, providing Tier 3 support and leading incident response to minimize downtime across on-prem and cloud systems.
* **Security & Compliance:** Maintain a strong security baseline across platform and cloud services and ensure compliance with standards such as SOC 2 and PCI-DSS.
* **Mentorship, Collaboration & Documentation:** Guide and mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE/DevOps best practices; partner with development, architecture, and security teams, and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards.

**Key Skills & Qualifications**
===============================

**1. Compute & Storage Skills**
-------------------------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT infrastructure engineering experience, with a proven track record in global enterprise environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across Operating Systems (Windows and Linux), enterprise storage, backup (Veeam or similar), and virtualization/hyper-converged systems (Nutanix), including physical infrastructure in on-prem or hybrid environments.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) and core security practices (SSL/TLS, SSH, encryption, LDAP).
* Experience with configuration management (Chef, Ansible, Puppet) and orchestration platforms (CloudBolt, Rundeck).
* Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, Shell, PowerShell) to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
* Relevant industry certifications (Microsoft, Red Hat, Nutanix, VMware, backup/storage, Cisco, or security-related) are a plus.

**2. Cloud Skills**
-------------------

* Deep, hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, database, and security services; multi-cloud or hybrid cloud experience preferred.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager) and cloud networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity).
* Experience leading migration of on-premises applications and data to the cloud.
* Demonstrated experience driving FinOps strategies to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance or security.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
* Professional-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle.

**Education**
=============

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

title: Senior Security Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**

The Cybersecurity Architecture Reviewer is responsible for conducting security architecture assessments for applications, platforms, cloud services, infrastructure, and technology solutions to ensure alignment with enterprise security policies, architectural standards, and industry best practices. The role includes reviewing firewall connectivity requests, network security designs, and application integrations to identify risks and recommend secure solutions while enabling business delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct cybersecurity architecture reviews for new and existing applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology solutions.

* Review cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and third-party integrations to ensure secure architectural design and connectivity patterns.

* Assess solution designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, technical documentation, and technical requirements from a security perspective.

* Review firewall and network access requests to validate compliance with approved architectures, security standards, and business requirements.

* Evaluate security controls, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, and data protection mechanisms.

* Partner with Solution Architects, Engineering Teams, and Project Teams to embed security requirements into solution designs and development initiatives.

* Perform firewall policy reviews across traditional, next-generation, and virtualized firewall platforms.

* Design, implement, and support firewall governance processes, including rule recertification, change management, audit traceability, and exception management.

* Design and assess secure connectivity patterns aligned with enterprise security principles, architectural standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Provide security recommendations, architectural guidance, and risk mitigation strategies based on industry best practices and organizational standards.

* Support governance activities, including periodic access reviews, firewall rule recertification, security exception reviews, and compliance assessments.

* Operate and maintain metrics, dashboards, and reporting to measure the effectiveness and efficiency of the Security Architecture function.

* Document security findings, risks, recommendations, and review outcomes, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and remediation tracking.

* Evangelise Security Architecture as an enabler as opposed to a blocking point



**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture principles and secure solution design practices.
* Experience reviewing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-premises infrastructures, and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, proxies, VPNs, network segmentation, and secure remote access solutions.
* Experience with firewall platforms such as Palo Alto, Check Point, Fortinet, Cisco FMC/FTD, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of authentication protocols, Identity and Access Management (IAM), encryption technologies, PKI, and key management.
* Experience conducting threat modelling, risk assessments, and security architecture reviews.
* Understanding of API security, SaaS security, vendor risk management, and third-party connectivity assessments.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, OWASP, and Zero Trust Architecture.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate technical risks into business-focused recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Experience working in highly regulated industries, including Financial Services, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, or Critical Infrastructure sectors.
* Hands-on experience with security architecture governance, firewall review processes /FW operations and compliance activities.
* Experience operating security review processes, risk management frameworks, and enterprise security governance programs.

**Experience Level**

Typically 7-14+ years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 5 years in Security Architecture, Security Review, or Network Security Governance roles
